'''Teg Kithri''' was a settlement that was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Budpock]]. During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Threnda]] operated a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the settlement, and in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] journeyed to Teg Kithri to destroy Threnda's supplies of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]].
